items.title: Safety Technology Is Only as Good as the Trust Behind It
items.content_html:
Every carrier with a safety technology program eventually learns the same lesson: the hardware is the easy part. Cameras can be mounted, collision mitigation can be specified on new tractors, and telematics can be switched on.
